note: Java bridge hardening. Bridge: the app name in DispatchEvent, metrics tags and logs is bounded (_default, allowlisted, proven-registered or UNKNOWN; Micrometer timers cached); vespera.bridge.max-buffered-response-bytes is forwarded to the native cap and an oversized SYNC/ASYNC response answers 500 instead of 413; new vespera.bridge.cors=rust|spring (default rust routes CORS preflights to the Rust router, duplicate Access-Control-* headers resolved per owner); proxy errors send a generic message and keep filter-set headers; ASYNC propagates the requestId MDC, records a Spring async timeout once as 503 and serves the body without a copy (DeferredResult); Windows native extraction checks directory owner and ACL and falls back to a fresh random directory; a missing native library answers 503, a vespera Actuator health indicator reports UP/DOWN/OUT_OF_SERVICE, and init fails on a bridge/native major.minor mismatch (vespera.native.versionCheck=warn|off). JNI: new nativeVersion0 symbol reporting the crate version. Gradle plugin: hyphenated crate names (packageName/libName), configuration-cache compatible, cargoBuild no longer fingerprints source trees (cargoSourceRoots deprecated), bridgeVersion defaults to the matching bridge release.
